name: Free Lunch Lab: Germany: figures for the cost of a basic income
description: The official figures behind the Germany cost essay: population, tax revenue, federal budget, GDP and government revenue, each with its source and date.
license: CC BY 4.0 (figures from the official sources named in each entry)
about: Official figures behind the essay germany-merz-basic-income-cost (cost of a basic income in Germany at four monthly amounts). build.js recomputes the essay's cost table from this file and the calculator data (CALC_WORLD, for the poverty line) and warns on drift; brand/x/infographics/render.js draws the X images from it. Amounts in euros.

taxRevenue.note: all taxes before distribution: federal, Länder, municipalities and the EU share

federalBudget.note: expenditure as passed by the Bundestag on 28 November 2025

governmentRevenue.note: general government revenue incl. social contributions (ESA 2010), Destatis as of 30 September 2026

levels.note: the World Bank's $3.00-a-day poverty line in German prices, from the calculator data (CALC_WORLD de line.monthly)

offsets.note: SGB II benefit entitlements (Zahlungsansprüche), excluding administration; 5,316,378 recipients; EUR 731 a month per recipient
Kindergeld paid by the BA Familienkasse, 17.57 million children
